title: Dock & Undock Panels
description: Rearrange the default layout and save a custom layout.
problemStatement:
**Goal:** Customise your editor and save the layout for later.

1. Drag the **Content Browser** tab and dock it on the **left** side of the viewport.
2. Drag the **World Outliner** tab to be a tab **next to** the Details Panel (so they share the same space).
3. Undock the **Output Log** and make it a floating window.
4. Hide the **Modes Panel** by right‑clicking its tab and choosing **Hide Tab**.
5. Go to **Window → Save Layout** and name it `My Chapter 2 Layout`.
6. Restore the default layout via **Window → Load Layout → Default Editor Layout**.
7. Load your saved layout again to confirm it works.
hints: You can dock a panel by dragging its tab to the edge of another panel until a blue highlight appears.
If a panel disappears, re‑enable it from the Window menu.
expectedOutput: A custom layout saved and loadable. The default layout can be restored at any time.
